purpose: Record five further lower-tail duplicate checks, including one relationship within the existing federalism cluster.

findings.subject: Use of English
findings.question_b: Choose the word nearest in meaning to 'ephemeral'.
findings.reason: Both ask for the synonym of the same word and have the same correct answer. Distractor changes do not create a new assessment objective.

findings.subject: Economics
findings.concept: Negative externality imposes external costs on third parties outside the transaction
findings.question_a: A negative externality occurs when an economic activity imposes…
options_a: A cost on a third party not fully reflected in the market price
A benefit only on the producer
No effect outside the buyer and seller
A tax refund on the consumer
findings.question_b: A negative production externality exists when
options_b: the private cost of production exceeds every social benefit.
some production costs are imposed on third parties who are not part of the transaction.
consumers pay exactly the full social cost.
the government sets the market price at equilibrium.
findings.reason: Both define the same negative externality concept: third parties bear costs not fully reflected in the market transaction.

findings.subject: Biology
findings.concept: Most oxygen in human blood is transported by haemoglobin in red blood cells
findings.question_a: Most oxygen in human blood is transported
findings.question_b: Which blood component contains haemoglobin and transports most oxygen in humans?
findings.reason: Both assess the same fact: most oxygen is carried by haemoglobin inside red blood cells.

findings.subject: Chemistry
findings.concept: Crystallisation is used to obtain purified crystals of a soluble solid from solution
findings.question_a: Which method is most suitable for obtaining pure crystals of copper(II) sulfate from its aqueous solution?
findings.question_b: Which technique is commonly used to obtain pure crystals of a soluble solid from its solution?
findings.reason: Both test the same separation method and objective: obtaining pure crystals of a soluble solid from its solution.

findings.subject: Government
findings.concept: Federalism constitutionally divides powers between central and constituent governments
findings.reason: Both are already part of the four-row federalism cluster documented in DUP-28, DUP-102 and DUP-113. This adds a further pairwise relationship but no new unique held row.

controls.note: DUP-136 is an additional relationship inside the already reconciled federalism cluster; it does not add a new target. The other four pairs each add one unique held candidate pending provenance and staging.
